Julius sentence now that the Ireland reference is removed.
Opening of the interview at 'A woman was standing by the fireplace.'
risks: The word count is estimated near 1500 and has not been measured.
The Rysdale bluff is now a single reported line, so the comic build-up is thinner.
summary: Removed about 440 words, chiefly from narration surrounding the recruitment, disguise, Julius, Carter's letter, the arrival logistics and Rita's portrait. All seven protected excerpts, the Albert/Cowley/Ritz arrangements, the Llanelly reference, the V.A.D. cover, the Paddington box and the closing unease are preserved.
